name: bobbymaher/funnypot-core
description: funnypot core engine: turn a scanner's own nuclei detection template into a matching fake-vulnerable HTTP response. Pure-PHP runtime, inert by default.

suggest.ext-sodium: Required only for the pure-PHP SSH honeypot server (Protocol\Ssh): curve25519 key exchange + ed25519 host key.
suggest.ext-openssl: Required only for the pure-PHP SSH honeypot server (Protocol\Ssh): the aes256-ctr transport cipher.
suggest.symfony/yaml: Required only to compile templates (bin/funnypot). Runtime needs PHP alone.
suggest.illuminate/support: Required only to use the Laravel bridge (Laravel\FunnypotServiceProvider).
suggest.psr/http-server-middleware: Required only to use the PSR-15 adapter (Http\HoneypotMiddleware).
suggest.psr/http-message: Required only to use the PSR-15 adapter (Http\PsrRequestMapper / Http\PsrResponseMapper).
suggest.psr/http-factory: Required only to use the PSR-15 adapter (response/stream factories passed to Http\HoneypotMiddleware).
